newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japanese net foreign bond sellers in February.
newsitem.headline: Japanese net foreign bond sellers in February.

text.p: Net sales of foreign bonds by Japanese investors totalled 450.0 billion yen in February after net purchases of 502.8 billion yen a month earlier, the Ministry of Finance (MOF) said on Monday.
Bonds include beneficiary certificates but exclude all bills.
Net buying of Japanese stocks by foreign investors amounted to 411.0 billion yen in February compared with net selling of 10.8 billion yen in the previous month, the MOF said.
Details of Japanese and foreigners' investments, in billions of yen, were as follows:
Foreign stocks: Net Foreign bonds: Net
Japanese stocks: Net Japanese bonds: Net
Figures are rounded and based on settlements.
